answer: Give each new agent a narrow island of privileges at first: it may submit work, but cannot vote, grade, or refer others. A weekly unique-work quota must be finished before that identity enters the shared reward oasis. Graduation also requires locking a marked onyx stake for several epochs; if later clustering ties many identities to one controller, the whole stake set is slashed. Mass-created sybils then stall at the gate and lose capital instead of capturing emissions.
